usbx_version.title: Middleware version
usbx_version.comment: label associated to the instance, can be overridden at sample level. In this case it becomes read-only.

profile_type.title: Profile selection
profile_type.description: Choose the configuration profile. The Default profile is a balanced choice between memory usage and performance.

actions.message: The Low footprint profile is currently not supported.
The High performance profile is currently not supported.

ux_standalone.description: When defined, this macro enables standalone mode. If this is disabled, add the RTOS pack.
ux_standalone.title: Select operating system

actions.message: Enable the FreeRTOS middleware to make this operating system available.
USBX is configured for FreeRTOS mode, but RTOS is not enabled in the project. Either switch USBX to 'No OS' or enable RTOS.
Enable xEventGroupSetBitFromISR and xTimerPendFunctionCall in the FreeRTOS advanced API selector when FreeRTOS mode is selected in USBX.

ux_thread_priority_enum.title: Enumeration thread priority
ux_thread_priority_enum.description: Priority value for the enumeration threads that monitor the bus topology.

actions.message: The DCD thread priority should be higher than the enumeration thread priority.
The HCD thread priority should be higher than the enumeration thread priority.
Select FreeRTOS as the operating system to configure this setting.

ux_thread_priority_class.title: Class thread priority
ux_thread_priority_class.description: Priority value for the class threads that monitor the bus topology.

actions.message: The DCD thread priority should be higher than the class thread priority.
The HCD thread priority should be higher than the class thread priority.
Select FreeRTOS as the operating system to configure this setting.

ux_thread_stack_size.description: Stack size for the threads. Typical values are 1024 or 2048 depending on the processor used and the host controller.
ux_thread_stack_size.title: Thread stack size

actions.message: Select FreeRTOS as the operating system to configure this setting.

ux_enable_error_checking.title: Error checking
ux_enable_error_checking.description: Turn on basic error checking to help identify issues during development and debugging, then disable this option in production for better performance.

ux_enable_param_checking.title: Parameter checking
ux_enable_param_checking.description: Enable validation of function parameters to help catch issues during development, then disable in production to optimize performance.

ux_no_time_slice.title: No time slice
ux_no_time_slice.description: This value actually defines the time slice that will be used for threads.

actions.message: Select FreeRTOS as the operating system to configure this setting.

ux_name_referenced_by_pointer.title: Reference names by pointer
ux_name_referenced_by_pointer.description: When enabled, structure names are referenced by pointer instead of by string content. This can improve performance by comparing pointers rather than string contents, but requires that all name strings are unique and persistent.

ux_enforce_safe_alignment.title: Enforce safe memory alignment
ux_enforce_safe_alignment.description: When enabled, the memory allocation scheme will enforce alignment of memory with the UX_SAFE_ALIGN field. This is important for platforms that require specific memory alignment for correct operation or performance.

ux_align_min.title: Minimum memory alignment
ux_align_min.description: Specifies the minimum number of bytes for memory alignment when allocating memory. Proper alignment can improve performance and is required by some hardware platforms.

ux_debug_log_size.title: Debug log buffer size
ux_debug_log_size.description: Sets the size in bytes of the debug log buffer used for storing debug messages. Increase this value if you need to capture more debug information.

ux_periodic_rate.title: Periodic rate
ux_periodic_rate.description: This value represents how many ticks per seconds for a specific hardware platform.

actions.message: Select FreeRTOS as the operating system to configure this setting.

ux_control_transfer_timeout.title: Control transfer timeout
ux_control_transfer_timeout.description: Specify the timeout value for control transfers in milliseconds.

ux_non_control_transfer_timeout.title: Non control transfer timeout
ux_non_control_transfer_timeout.description: Specify the timeout value for non-control transfers in milliseconds.

hid_class.title: HID class
hid_class.description: Activate the USB Human Interface Device (HID) class support so you can choose mouse, keyboard, or custom HID devices.

actions.message: Enable the HID device class to display this section.

ux_device_class_hid_event_buffer_length.title: Event buffer length
ux_device_class_hid_event_buffer_length.description: Maximum size in bytes of a single HID report or event that the device can buffer or send in one transfer.

ux_device_class_hid_max_events_queue.title: Maximum events queue
ux_device_class_hid_max_events_queue.description: Maximum number of HID reports/events that can be queued before being transmitted to the host.

ux_device_class_hid_zero_copy.title: HID zero copy
ux_device_class_hid_zero_copy.description: Activate zero-copy mode with the flexible HID queue. The internal queue buffer is used directly for USB transfers. Requires the endpoint buffer owner to be set to 'Class Managed'.

device_mouse.title: Device mouse
device_mouse.description: Activate the HID mouse device function so the MCU can act as a USB mouse.

actions.message: Enable the HID device class to show this option.

usbd_hid_mouse_endpoint_in_addr.title: Endpoint IN address
usbd_hid_mouse_endpoint_in_addr.description: Interrupt IN endpoint address used by the HID mouse. Ensure this address is unique when multiple USB device classes are enabled.

usbd_hid_mouse_endpoint_in_fs_mps.title: Endpoint IN full speed maximum packet size

usbd_hid_mouse_endpoint_in_fs_binterval.title: Endpoint IN full speed bInterval

usbd_hid_mouse_endpoint_in_hs_binterval.title: Endpoint IN high speed bInterval
usbd_hid_mouse_endpoint_in_hs_binterval.description: Polling interval (bInterval) in microframes for the HID mouse interrupt IN endpoint at high speed.

ux_device_class_hid_interrupt_out_suppor.title: Custom HID interrupt OUT endpoint
ux_device_class_hid_interrupt_out_suppor.description: Enable support for HID interrupt OUT endpoint. When enabled, the device can receive data from the host over the HID interrupt OUT endpoint.

usbd_hid_custom_endpoint_out_addr.description: Interrupt OUT endpoint address used by the custom HID interface. Ensure this address is unique when multiple USB device classes are enabled.

cdc_acm_class.title: CDC ACM class
cdc_acm_class.description: Activate the USB Communication Device Class (CDC ACM) so the device can appear as a virtual COM (serial) port to the host.

actions.message: Enable the CDC ACM device class to display this section.

ux_device_class_cdc_acm_transmission_dis.title: CDC ACM transmission
ux_device_class_cdc_acm_transmission_dis.description: Deactivate non-blocking CDC ACM transmission. When activated, CDC ACM uses only blocking (synchronous) transmissions.

ux_device_class_cdc_acm_write_auto_zlp.title: CDC ACM write auto ZLP
ux_device_class_cdc_acm_write_auto_zlp.description: Automatically send a Zero-Length Packet (ZLP) when needed to correctly terminate a bulk transfer (for example, when the payload size is an exact multiple of the endpoint maximum packet size).

ux_device_class_cdc_acm_zero_copy.title: CDC ACM zero copy
ux_device_class_cdc_acm_zero_copy.description: Activate zero-copy mode on CDC ACM bulk endpoints to avoid extra data copies. Requires endpoint buffer owner set to 'Class Managed' and application buffers that are properly aligned and cache-safe.

actions.message: Enable the CDC ACM device class to display this section.

usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_in_cmd_addr.title: Endpoint command IN address
usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_in_cmd_addr.description: Endpoint number for the CDC ACM notification (interrupt IN) endpoint. Keep this unique across all configured device endpoints.

actions.message: A default CDC ACM command IN endpoint address is assigned automatically.
Please select a unique IN endpoint address. Another device class already uses this IN endpoint number.

usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_in_addr.title: Endpoint IN address

usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_out_addr.title: Endpoint OUT address

usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_in_cmd_fs_mps.description: Maximum packet size in bytes for the CDC ACM notification (interrupt IN) endpoint at full speed.

usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_in_cmd_fs_binterva.title: Endpoint command IN full speed bInterval
usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_in_cmd_fs_binterva.description: Polling interval in milliseconds for the CDC ACM notification (interrupt IN) endpoint at full speed.

usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_in_fs_mps.title: Endpoint IN full speed maximum packet size
usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_in_fs_mps.description: Maximum packet size in bytes for the CDC ACM data IN (bulk IN) endpoint at full speed.

usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_in_fs_binterval.title: Endpoint IN full speed bInterval
usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_in_fs_binterval.description: Polling interval value (bInterval)  for the CDC ACM data IN (bulk IN) endpoint at full speed. Bulk endpoints do not use polling intervals, so this must be 0.

usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_out_fs_mps.title: Endpoint OUT full speed maximum packet size
usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_out_fs_mps.description: Maximum packet size in bytes for the CDC ACM data OUT (bulk OUT) endpoint at full speed.

usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_out_fs_binterval.title: Endpoint OUT full speed bInterval
usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_out_fs_binterval.description: Polling interval value (bInterval)  for the CDC ACM data OUT (bulk OUT) endpoint at full speed. Bulk endpoints do not use polling intervals, so this must be 0.

usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_in_cmd_hs_mps.title: Endpoint command IN high speed maximum packet size
usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_in_cmd_hs_mps.description: Maximum packet size in bytes for the CDC ACM notification (interrupt IN) endpoint at high speed.

usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_in_hs_binterval.title: Endpoint IN high speed bInterval
usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_in_hs_binterval.description: Polling interval value (bInterval)  for the CDC ACM data IN (bulk IN) endpoint at high speed. Bulk endpoints do not use polling intervals, so this must be 0.

usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_out_hs_mps.description: Maximum packet size in bytes for the CDC ACM data OUT (bulk OUT) endpoint at high speed.

usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_out_hs_binterval.title: Endpoint OUT high speed bInterval
usbd_cdc_acm_endpoint_out_hs_binterval.description: Polling interval value (bInterval)  for the CDC ACM data OUT (bulk OUT) endpoint at high speed. Bulk endpoints do not use polling intervals, so this must be 0.

dfu_class.title: DFU class
dfu_class.description: Activate the USB Device Firmware Upgrade (DFU) class so the device can be updated over USB.

actions.message: Enable the DFU device class to display this section.

dfu_upload_disable.title: DFU upload
dfu_upload_disable.description: Deactivate DFU Upload (host reading data back from the device). When activated, DFU Upload requests from the host are rejected.

dfu_error_get_enable.title: DFU error get
dfu_error_get_enable.description: Allow DFU_GETSTATUS and DFU_GETSTATE requests to be handled even when the device is in an error state.

dfu_status_mode.title: DFU status mode
dfu_status_mode.description: Activate simplified handling for DFU status and state requests.

dfu_custom_request_enable.title: Custom request
dfu_custom_request_enable.description: Use the application callback to handle custom DFU requests that are not part of the standard DFU command set.

dfu_status_polltimeout.title: DFU status poll timeout
dfu_status_polltimeout.description: Value reported to the host as DFU bPollTimeout (how long the host should wait before requesting DFU status again). Encoded according to the DFU specification.

dfu_media_erase_time.title: Media erase time
dfu_media_erase_time.description: Value reported to the host to indicate the erase time of the target media (used in DFU status responses). Encoded according to the DFU specification.

dfu_media_program_time.title: Media program time
dfu_media_program_time.description: Value reported to the host to indicate the program (write) time of the target media (used in DFU status responses). Encoded according to the DFU specification.

actions.message: Enable the DFU device class to display this section.

dfu_xfer_size.title: DFU transfer size
dfu_xfer_size.description: Maximum number of bytes per DFU download block (control OUT packet). Choose a value that matches your flash page size and bandwidth requirements.

dfu_media.title: DFU media
dfu_media.description: Memory layout string presented to DFU host tools (such as dfu-util). It describes the target flash regions, addresses, and block sizes.

dfu_bm_attributes.title: DFU bm attributes
dfu_bm_attributes.description: DFU functional attributes bitmask indicating support for download/upload, manifestation tolerance, and detach capability, as reported in the DFU functional descriptor.

dfu_detach_timeout.title: DFU detach timeout
dfu_detach_timeout.description: Time in milliseconds that the device waits after a DFU_DETACH request before leaving DFU mode or resetting.

audio_class.title: Audio class
audio_class.description: Activate the USB Audio Device Class so the device can stream audio to or from the host.

actions.message: Enable the Audio device class to display this section.

audio_feedback_support.title: Device audio feedback support
audio_feedback_support.description: Use an audio feedback endpoint (asynchronous audio) to report the actual sampling rate to the host and help keep host and device clocks synchronized.

ux_device_class_audio_feedback_endpoint_.title: Audio feedback endpoint buffer size
ux_device_class_audio_feedback_endpoint_.description: Buffer size in bytes for the audio feedback endpoint. Used only when the endpoint buffer owner is set to 'Class Managed'. Typically larger than the endpoint's maximum packet size.

actions.message: Enable device audio feedback support to configure this setting.

audio_interrupt_support.title: Device audio interrupt endpoint support
audio_interrupt_support.description: Use the optional Audio interrupt endpoint, if your audio descriptors define it (for control or status notifications).

usbd_audio_endpoint_in_addr.description: Endpoint number used for the Audio IN endpoint (device-to-host). Keep it unique across all device classes in a composite device.

usbd_audio_endpoint_out_addr.title: Endpoint OUT address
usbd_audio_endpoint_out_addr.description: Endpoint number used for the Audio OUT endpoint (host-to-device). Keep it unique across all device classes in a composite device.

Please select a unique OUT endpoint address. Another device class already uses this OUT endpoint number.

usbd_audio_endpoint_feedback_addr.title: Endpoint feedback address
usbd_audio_endpoint_feedback_addr.description: Endpoint number used for the optional Audio feedback IN endpoint. Keep it unique across all device classes; used only when the audio descriptors include a feedback endpoint.

Please select a unique IN endpoint address. Another device class already uses this IN endpoint number.

usbd_audio_endpoint_interrupt_addr.title: Endpoint interrupt address
usbd_audio_endpoint_interrupt_addr.description: Endpoint number used for the optional Audio interrupt IN endpoint. Keep it unique across all device classes; used only when the audio descriptors include an interrupt endpoint.

usbd_audio_endpoint_in_fs_mps.description: Maximum packet size in bytes for the Audio IN endpoint at full speed. Choose a value that matches your audio format and available USB bandwidth.

usbd_audio_endpoint_in_fs_binterval.title: Endpoint IN full speed bInterval
usbd_audio_endpoint_in_fs_binterval.description: Transfer interval for the Audio IN endpoint at full speed, in 1 ms frames. A value of 1 is typical for isochronous audio.

usbd_audio_endpoint_out_fs_mps.title: Endpoint OUT full speed maximum packet size
usbd_audio_endpoint_out_fs_mps.description: Maximum packet size in bytes for the Audio OUT endpoint at full speed. Choose a value that matches your audio format and available USB bandwidth.

usbd_audio_endpoint_out_fs_binterval.title: Endpoint OUT full speed bInterval
usbd_audio_endpoint_out_fs_binterval.description: Transfer interval for the Audio OUT endpoint at full speed, in 1 ms frames. A value of 1 is typical for isochronous audio.

usbd_audio_endpoint_feedback_fs_mps.title: Endpoint feedback full speed maximum packet size
usbd_audio_endpoint_feedback_fs_mps.description: Maximum packet size in bytes for the Audio feedback endpoint at full speed (often 3 bytes for UAC feedback data).

usbd_audio_endpoint_feedback_fs_binterva.title: Endpoint feedback full speed bInterval

usbd_audio_endpoint_interrupt_fs_mps.title: Endpoint interrupt full speed maximum packet size
usbd_audio_endpoint_interrupt_fs_mps.description: Maximum packet size in bytes for the optional Audio interrupt endpoint at full speed, used for control or status notifications.

usbd_audio_endpoint_interrupt_fs_binterv.title: Endpoint interrupt full speed bInterval
usbd_audio_endpoint_interrupt_fs_binterv.description: Polling interval for the optional Audio interrupt endpoint at full speed, in milliseconds.

usbd_audio_endpoint_in_hs_mps.title: Endpoint IN high speed maximum packet size
usbd_audio_endpoint_in_hs_mps.description: Maximum packet size in bytes for the Audio IN endpoint at high speed. Must be large enough for the audio payload per (micro)frame.

usbd_audio_endpoint_in_hs_binterval.title: Endpoint IN high speed bInterval
usbd_audio_endpoint_in_hs_binterval.description: Transfer interval for the Audio IN endpoint at high speed. For high speed isochronous/interrupt endpoints, bInterval uses the USB-defined encoding.

usbd_audio_endpoint_out_hs_mps.title: Endpoint OUT high speed maximum packet size
usbd_audio_endpoint_out_hs_mps.description: Maximum packet size in bytes for the Audio OUT endpoint at high speed. Must be large enough for the audio payload per (micro)frame.

usbd_audio_endpoint_out_hs_binterval.title: Endpoint OUT high speed bInterval
usbd_audio_endpoint_out_hs_binterval.description: Transfer interval for the Audio OUT endpoint at high speed. For high speed isochronous/interrupt endpoints, bInterval uses the USB-defined encoding.

usbd_audio_endpoint_feedback_hs_mps.title: Endpoint feedback high speed maximum packet size

actions.message: Enable device audio feedback support to configure this setting.

usbd_audio_endpoint_feedback_hs_binterva.title: Endpoint feedback high speed bInterval
usbd_audio_endpoint_feedback_hs_binterva.description: Transfer interval for the Audio feedback endpoint at high speed. For high speed isochronous/interrupt endpoints, bInterval uses the USB-defined encoding.

ux_host_class_storage_memory_buffer_size.title: Storage memory buffer size
ux_host_class_storage_memory_buffer_size.description: Size in bytes of the host mass-storage transfer buffer used to hold read/write payload data.

ux_max_host_lun.title: Maximum host LUN
ux_max_host_lun.description: Maximum number of Logical Unit Numbers (LUNs) that the host storage driver will enumerate per USB storage device.

ux_host_class_storage_no_filex.title: No file system support for storage
ux_host_class_storage_no_filex.description: Disable file-system integration for host storage so the application can access the media at the raw block level without mounting a file system.

ux_host_class_storage_max_media.title: Maximum storage media
ux_host_class_storage_max_media.description: Maximum number of storage media units that the host storage class can manage at the same time.

ux_host_class_storage_include_legacy_pro.title: Include legacy protocol support
ux_host_class_storage_include_legacy_pro.description: Add support for legacy mass-storage protocols (CB/CBI) used by older USB storage devices (for example, some floppy drives).

ux_host_class_storage_max_transfer_size.title: Maximum transfer size
ux_host_class_storage_max_transfer_size.description: Maximum number of bytes transferred in a single SCSI data phase for read/write operations.

hub_class.title: HUB class
hub_class.description: Activate the USB Hub class so the host stack can enumerate devices connected through external USB hubs.

actions.message: Enable the USB host HUB class to display this section.

ux_max_roothub_port.title: Maximum root hub port
ux_max_roothub_port.description: Number of root-hub ports exposed to the host stack. Set this to match the number of physical ports supported by the root hub.

printer_class.title: Printer class
printer_class.description: Activate the USB Host Printer class so the host can communicate with USB printer devices.

pima_mtp_class.title: PIMA MTP class
pima_mtp_class.description: Activate the USB Host PIMA / Media Transfer Protocol (MTP) class so the host can access media content on compatible devices (for example, cameras, phones).

actions.message: The PIMA/MTP host class requires RTOS mode. Select FreeRTOS in USBX and enable RTOS in the project to continue.

audio_class.title: Audio class
audio_class.description: Activate the USB Host Audio class so the host can stream audio to and/or from USB audio devices (headsets, speakers, microphones).

actions.message: The USB host Audio class requires RTOS mode. Select FreeRTOS in USBX and enable RTOS in the project to continue.
Enable the USB host Audio class to display this section.

ux_host_class_audio_2_support.title: Audio 2.0 support
ux_host_class_audio_2_support.description: Enable Audio Class 2.0 (UAC2) support in the host stack for high-resolution and multi-channel audio devices.

ux_host_class_audio_feedback_support.title: Audio feedback support
ux_host_class_audio_feedback_support.description: Add host-side support for audio feedback endpoints used by asynchronous audio devices to report their effective sampling rate.

ux_host_class_audio_interrupt_support.title: Interrupt endpoint support
ux_host_class_audio_interrupt_support.description: Activate support for optional Audio interrupt endpoints on the host side (for example, for control or status notifications).

video_class.title: Video class
video_class.description: Activate the USB Host Video class (UVC) so the host can receive video streams from USB cameras and capture devices.

actions.message: The USB host Video class requires RTOS mode. Select FreeRTOS in USBX and enable RTOS in the project to continue.

gser_class.title: GSER class
gser_class.description: Activate the USB Host Generic Serial (GSER) class to support devices that expose vendor-specific serial interfaces.

actions.message: The USB host GSER class requires RTOS mode. Select FreeRTOS in USBX and enable RTOS in the project to continue.

prolific_class.title: Prolific class
prolific_class.description: Activate the USB Host Prolific class driver for Prolific USB-to-serial bridge devices (for example, PL2303).

actions.message: The USB host Prolific class requires RTOS mode. Select FreeRTOS in USBX and enable RTOS in the project to continue.

swar_class.title: SWAR class
swar_class.description: Activate the USB Host SWAR class driver for supported SWAR-based serial/adapter devices.

actions.message: The USB host SWAR class requires RTOS mode. Select FreeRTOS in USBX and enable RTOS in the project to continue.

ux_host_hnp_polling_thread_stack.description: Stack size in bytes for the Host Negotiation Protocol (HNP) polling thread used in OTG/dual-role scenarios.
ux_host_hnp_polling_thread_stack.title: HNP polling thread stack

ux_host_stack_configuration_instance_cre.title: Host stack control instance
ux_host_stack_configuration_instance_cre.description: Create and initialize the host stack instance so the MCU can operate as a USB host and manage attached devices. Leave this deactivated if the application does not use host mode.

ux_host_side_only.title: Host side only
ux_host_side_only.description: Build only the host stack and omit the device stack to reduce code size and RAM usage when the MCU is used strictly as a USB host.

ux_enable_assert.title: Assert support
ux_enable_assert.description: Enable internal assertions to catch programming or configuration errors during development. Disable them for production builds to reduce overhead.

ux_max_classes.title: Maximum classes
ux_max_classes.description: Maximum number of different host class types that can be registered (for example, HID, MSC, CDC). This does not limit how many devices of each class can be connected.

ux_max_tt.title: Maximum transaction translators
ux_max_tt.description: Maximum number of Transaction Translators (TTs) supported by the host stack. TTs are used by USB 2.0 hubs to handle full-/low-speed devices behind a high speed hub.

ux_host_device_class_code_validation_ena.title: Host device class code validation
ux_host_device_class_code_validation_ena.description: Validate USB class/subclass/protocol codes reported by devices during enumeration to help detect non-compliant or unexpected devices.

ux_max_devices.title: Maximum devices
ux_max_devices.description: Maximum number of USB devices (including hubs and their downstream devices) that the host stack can enumerate at the same time. Reducing this value saves RAM.

usbx_system_stack_size.title: System stack size
usbx_system_stack_size.description: Total size in bytes of the system memory pool used for internal objects, threads, classes, transfers, and control structures. Increase this if you add more classes or endpoints.

usbx_device_generate_init_code.title: Device generate init code
usbx_device_generate_init_code.description: When enabled, STM32CubeMX automatically generates device initialization code. This requires an RTOS and at least one device class to be selected.

ux_thread_priority_hcd.title: HCD thread priority
ux_thread_priority_hcd.description: RTOS priority for the Host Controller Driver (HCD) thread. Raise this if host controller processing must preempt other tasks.
